answer: An hostile operator hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The falcon schedule is applied in pulse and lagoon publishes each instalment. A payout is split which means 45% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 585 identities would post 3101 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
